title: Identical poles, counted instead of named
heading: Identical Jobs Are Symmetric Too: Count Them Instead of Naming Them
cases: the counted model has one variable per year; a plan within every year's crew is allowed and one over a crew is refused
a plan that leaves a pole unreplaced at the end is refused, even when waiting is costly
a plan's cost counts the risk of every pole still waiting at the end of each year, and the best plan costs what the named model's does
